Steering Movement

Steering-based movement for AI entities using seek/flee/wander behaviors.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "steeringMovement": {}
}

Description

The Steering Movement component provides steering-based movement for AI entities. It implements classic steering behaviors such as seek, flee, and wander, allowing AI-controlled entities to navigate the game world with natural-looking movement patterns.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
Steering behaviors are configured through the AI component's behavior tree.

Example

JSON
{
  "steeringMovement": {}
}
